name: Whisper
description: OpenAI's Whisper through faster-whisper: accurate transcripts in about 100 languages with timestamps, and translation into English. Fast on the CPU, faster on an NVIDIA GPU.

options.label: Model
options.help: Downloads the first time it's used. Turbo is nearly as accurate as Large and much faster.

options.label: Skip silence
options.help: Finds the speech first; faster, and avoids made-up text in silent parts.

options.label: Beam size
options.help: Higher is a little more accurate and slower.

options.label: Vocabulary hint
options.help: Words that appear in the recording, to spell them right.
